messages:
sam: FYI new quant bring-up (nightjar-v2q) — our structured-invoke canary shows schema fail rate jump from 0.7% -> 4.8% in streaming mode. attaching a couple of traces.

maya: ugh. do you have sample payloads? is this in dedicated or hosted? :thinking_face:

sam: hosted canary (region-us-east1). sample trace:
```json
{"request_id":"r-1234","model":"nightjar-v2q","mode":"stream","response":"{\"action\": \"update\", \"params\": [1,\n"}
```
notice trailing newline/fragmented array — looks like the stream cut in the middle of an array element.

reza: ok that looks like suffix cut mid-array. are we hitting early EOS or token-length trunc? can you paste the request prompt and token counts?

sam: prompt length ~620 tokens, max_seq 1024, but kv-prefix batching yields different effective max in the canary profile. quick metrics: parse_failures: 48/1000 calls, retries+repair succeeded 20, final failures 28.

claire: hypothesis: quantized int4 attention kernel emitted a controlchar/sequence that the tokenizer collapses, causing off-by-one when chunking stream. i've seen a similar fingerprint before. can we try disabling kv-prefix for the canary?

sam: tried that — disabling kv-prefix reduced failures to 1.6% but p95 latency +12ms. logs: `/opt/runtime/logs/stream-frames.log` snippet:
```text
frame 120: chunk="...,\n]" truncated
frame 121: chunk="}\n" <-- not merged
```

reza: can we repro locally with `nightjar-v2q --stream-sim` + our quant runtime? want to replicate with same batch config and same tokenizer version.

maya: i'll spin up a small canary with kv-prefix off + increased buffer merge window. also will run the lightweight json-lint adapter on responses before parse to avoid firing SLO alerts immediately.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled by maya at 2026-03-23T15:12Z :rocket:

claire: if that reduces the failure rate we should land a small runtime mitigation: a post-process that re-assembles trailing fragments before JSON parse (escape-safe, idempotent). file a runtime PR and a unit test that fuzzes fragmented NDJSON.

sam: opened PR #2345 with tests and a tiny NDJSON concatenation heuristic + canary run plan. i'll post updated numbers after the next 2k calls.
